about: What the installer can set up beyond the app: software a widget needs, and the keys and addresses it asks for. Each is offered when any of its widgets is chosen. Hand-written; deploy/installer/plan.py reads it.

modules.name: Your location
modules.about: Where the weather, sunrise, pollen and tides are for. A postcode, town or city.

modules.name: A voice for the panel
modules.about: Piper, which runs on the Pi: reads notes and news aloud, says when a timer is done and which bin goes out, and speaks Home Assistant's answers. About 100 MB. Nothing is sent anywhere.
modules.action: Install piper, a voice for the panel

modules.name: Video player for YouTube, Floatplane and Nebula
modules.about: yt-dlp and deno, which find the video streams. Downloaded into ~/.local/share/homecanvas/bin, kept up to date by the panel. No root needed.
modules.action: Fetch yt-dlp and deno for the video player

modules.name: Spotify on the panel's speakers
modules.about: librespot, so the panel shows up as “Kiosk” in Spotify's device list and plays through its own speakers. Needs Spotify Premium. Debian and Raspberry Pi OS only.
modules.action: Install librespot, so Spotify can play on the panel

modules.name: Home Assistant
modules.about: For the Home Assistant widgets and the bridge page, and so voice control can pass on what the panel doesn't know (“turn off the lamp”). Make a token in Home Assistant: your name (bottom left) → Security → Long-lived access tokens.

modules.name: Homey
modules.about: For the Homey widgets. Make an API key at my.homey.app → Settings → API Keys, allowed to see and control devices and to see zones and flows.

presets.name: A good start
presets.about: The time, the weather, your calendar, the news, what's playing and a photo.

presets.name: The family's board
presets.about: Calendar, bins, shopping, meals, chores, birthdays and countdowns, around the clock and weather.

presets.name: Smart home
presets.about: Home Assistant's rooms and lights, electricity, the weather and the TV remote.

presets.name: Music, TV and video
presets.about: Now playing, YouTube, Floatplane and Nebula, the TV remote and your photo library.

presets.name: Home lab
presets.about: Servers, services, certificates, updates, the network and speed tests.
